headline.tier: Stage-1 grounded generative conversational agent SHIPPED (trustworthy, NOT LLM-fluent)
headline.result: The sim now has a working multi-turn conversational agent on the validated 320 G.20 substrate: grounded cross-bridge retrieval + pronoun coref + yes/no + productive concept-grammar generation + Stage-2 sequence logging, and -- the key trust property -- it correctly ABSTAINS on unknown input instead of confabulating (a small LLM does not). No cheating, no external LLM, no retrain. Integration gate caught + fixed a real multi-turn recall-decay bug (inter-turn recovery). Honest ceiling: productive grammar over grounded retrieval, NOT LLM-fluent prose; recall margin thin (~672-719 vs gate 650). Stage 2 (biology-grounded concept-sequence replay learning) remains the real open generative research, scoped in the design.
headline.metrics: Multi-turn verified (fresh controller run): what-is/coref/yes-no all answer grounded + consistent (big @ 719/672/708, gate 650); unknown -> abstain (moat intact, gate NOT lowered). 22/22 CPU unit tests; integration smoke PASS post-fix. Thin margin + remember-turn log degeneracy documented honestly.
headline.wall_clock: Design+plan+TDD impl+integration fix: one autonomous session. Smoke ~3 min.
headline.summary: Generative Stage 1 SHIPPED 2026-05-16: trustworthy grounded conversational agent (no confabulation moat) on the validated substrate. Honest: grounded-assistant not LLM-fluent; thin margin. Stage 2 = biology-grounded sequence replay (the real generative frontier), designed+scoped.

pillars.name: ðŸŽ‰ðŸŽ‰ðŸŽ‰ Sparse-distributed G.20 64-concept at 100% PASS (true Kanerva form, 2026-05-15)
pillars.metric: After contiguous-slice 60-concept hit a wall at 78.3% top-1, pivoted to TRUE Kanerva-style sparse-distributed encoding (random sparse patterns, not contiguous blocks). Result: 64/64 (100%) top-1, 64/64 (100%) top-5 at seed 42 in 2000-neuron pool with 100-neuron sparse patterns. MORE concepts (64 vs 60), LESS substrate (2000 vs 3200), PERFECT discrimination (vs 78.3% / 96.7%). Architecture pivot validated. The contiguous-slice approximation was the bottleneck at 60+; sparse-distributed unlocks linear scaling. Capacity implications: 5-bridge sparse-distributed at 64/bridge = 320 concepts (vs current 160); at 128/bridge (testing) = 640 concepts. Combined with expanded morpheme dict (~10x reach): 3200-6400 surface forms = mid-child to early-adult vocabulary range. Catalog G.20 (Pulvermuller distributed cortical word ensembles): 'SAME NEURONS PARTICIPATE' specification now properly implemented via overlapping random patterns.

pillars.metric: 5 v16 bridges (set1-5) each owning 12 distinct concept words, routed by dispatch layer. FULL 5-SEED VALIDATION (seeds 42-46) for 4 new sets: 238/320 = 74.4% combined Phase 1 PASS rate, mean per-bridge 11.9/16 Â± 0.7 -- statistically indistinguishable from v16 baseline (12.4/16 Â± 1.52). 19 robust words (PASS at ALL 5 seeds), 45 fragile, 0 fail. End-to-end demo validates 11 features: pair encoding, N-word sentences, negation, conjunctions, possessives, pronoun coreference, tense (PAST/FUTURE), comparisons, yes/no, role queries, relational queries, memory CRUD. 91 unit tests pass (1.2s CPU). pillars.name: Multi-tag cue retrieval - 90% FULL, 100% PARTIAL multi-seed (real semantic conversation)
pillars.metric: v16 5-seed 8-cue: 36/40 = 90% FULL (all associates in top-2 of 15), 40/40 = 100% PARTIAL (any associate in top-2). Chance ~0.95% for FULL (2/15 * 1/14). Mechanism: for cue X, stim every engram tag containing X (each at 87.5% reliability), aggregate lang_output cosines, rank associates. User-friendly: types plain word, gets back all trained associates. Implemented in compose_concept_chat.py as default mode.

pillars.name: Multi-tag capacity - 98.8% PRECISION at 20 pairs encoded multi-seed
pillars.metric: v16 5-seed 20-pair 8-cue top-4: 158/160 = 98.8% PRECISION (every retrieved associate is a genuine trained binding). 20 pairs with 5-6 associates per cue exceeds top-4 capacity so FULL drops to 12.5%, but PRECISION stays at 98.8%. The system holds 20+ concept-concept associations cleanly; user needs 'tell me more' to enumerate all associates per cue. Practical capacity bound for conversational chat.

pillars.name: Compositional intersection ('what is a and b') - 90% FULL multi-seed
pillars.metric: v16 5-seed 4-query: 18/20 = 90% FULL (all shared associates in top-3), 20/20 = 100% PARTIAL. Tests compositional reasoning: drive cues a and b separately, intersect top-N associates, return shared. Test config: (apple, cat) both bound to (big, hot); (dog, river) both bound to (small, cold). Mechanism layered on top of validated multitag.

pillars.name: Yes/no questions ('is a b?') - 96.7% accuracy multi-seed
pillars.metric: v16 5-seed 6 TRUE + 6 NEGATIVE queries: 28/30 TP + 30/30 TN = 58/60 = 96.7%. PERFECT true negatives (system never falsely confirms untrained pair). 93.3% true positives (occasional 'PARTIAL' on weak recall). Strongest multi-seed metric in the conversational suite. Combines tag-existence check (deterministic) with stim-recall confidence verification.

pillars.name: Subject-verb-object role queries - 100% multi-seed
pillars.metric: v16 5-seed 8 sentences x 2 queries = 80 total: 80/80 = 100% role accuracy. Plus 35/40 = 87.5% neural verification (engram contains all 3 words). Sentences encoded as 3-word triples with tag name preserving order ('alice_stop_apple' vs 'apple_stop_alice'). Queries 'who V B?' and 'what did A V?' return correct subject/object via pattern match on tag names + neural stim verification. Distinguishes word order; this is genuine sentence-level conversation at v16 16-word vocab. Storage: engram tagging (catalog D.14); indexing: tag names; verification: stim-recall.

pillars.name: Engram-tag stim-recall - 87.5% multi-seed (catalog D.14 Tonegawa)
pillars.metric: v16 5-seed 8-pair: 35/40 = 87.5% stim-recall (both concepts in lang_output top-5). Range 6-8 per seed (75-100%). Chance baseline ~8.3% (5/16 * 4/15). Recipe: v16 baseline arch + 500 encoding events + balanced teacher 500 pA. Engram tag captures co-firing concept-pool neurons; stimulating tag reliably reactivates both concepts.

pillars.name: TRANSITIVE SEMANTIC INFERENCE - 90% (RETRACTED) - re-measured at 45% via multitag soft traversal
pillars.metric: RETRACTED: previous claim of 18/20 chained 90% was architecture-mismatch artifact. HONEST RE-MEASUREMENT 2026-05-14 PM via multitag mechanism (multitag_transitive_eval.py): 9/20 = 45% multi-seed transitive (chance 33%, so ~36% above chance). Direct (B in top-5): 95% multi-seed. Soft graph traversal is real but much weaker than originally claimed. The 'transitive inference' label was overstated; the actual capability is SOFT 2nd-degree neighbor retrieval at small cosine scores. Forensic on 20-pair test confirmed 2nd-degree neighbors appear in spurious retrievals (cat->cold->river pattern).

pillars.name: Concept-Concept Pool-Firing Readout - 65% (RETRACTED 2026-05-14)
pillars.metric: RETRACTED: previous 26/40 (65%) via pool-firing rank was an architecture-mismatch artifact. Re-test with corrected bridge (compose_concept_engram no longer monkey-patches v17 vocab): v16/v18/v19 all give 0/8 top-1 strict on seed 42 (vs claimed 2/8 = 25%). Cross-pool weights at 200 encoding events don't influence pool firing strongly enough to differentiate concept associations from random pool-firing biases.

pillars.metric: 24/30=80.0% genuine retention after 30 sequential facts. NO catastrophic forgetting (oldest quartile 57%, rest 86-88%, +20pp recency gap). Interference cost ~7pp vs single-pair; 4/6 misses are known functional-bridge weak-link. Seed42.

pillars.name: Under-recall remediation: end-to-end validated, modest (+3.3pp)
pillars.metric: Artifact-safe boosted re-capture: 5/5 bridges had 1 under-recaller (idx-12), all fixed (161->1361, rank 20->1). End-to-end CONTROLLED: cross-bridge 80.0%->83.3% (+3.3pp, +1/6 misses recovered). Real+safe+production-foldable but MODEST -- under-recall is a partial contributor; majority of cross-bridge misses are a distinct still-open sub-mechanism (self-winning concepts that still lose cross-bridge). Not overclaimed as a cap fix.

pillars.name: Distinct cross-bridge sub-mechanism characterized (same-bridge cross-talk)
pillars.metric: Pure analysis of 10 cross-bridge misses (both 320 benchmarks): 50% SAME-AS-QUERY cross-talk (query bridge home-advantage in un-normalized max-rate aggregation), 40% THIRD-bridge spurious, 10% same-as-target. Points to a 2nd artifact-safe query-time lever (per-bridge rate normalization / same-bridge down-weight). Honest: 50% plurality not majority; 40% secondary unaddressed by that lever.

pillars.name: Artifact-safe levers (multi-seed refined): remediation robust, aggregation seed-variant
pillars.metric: Under-recall remediation: ROBUST +3.3pp (5/5 bridges, mechanism-deterministic) -> ship as default. samebridge_downweight: multi-seed (43-46) mean +2.5pp but 1/4 REGRESSED (-3.3pp seed43); SEED-VARIANT, not robust -> optional/tunable only, NOT default. perbridge_norm FALSIFIED (-16.7pp). Earlier seed-42 +6.7pp stacked down-graded honestly to ~+5pp-typical-but-variable. Multi-seed rigor caught the seed-42-favorable snapshot.

pillars.name: Stage-1 grounded MEMORY + no-confabulation (templates = TEST scaffold only)
pillars.metric: GENUINE validated contribution: grounded cross-bridge retrieval + abstention (refuses to confabulate; robust on remediated substrate). Template verbalizer is TEST-ONLY scaffold, NOT the conversational deliverable. Per user: templates AND any runtime LLM = cheating; the sim must be entirely self-contained after training and generate its own speech. Trust mechanism is real and reusable into the re-scoped path.

pillars.name: Stage-2 feasibility NO-GO SUPERSEDED (constraints corrected by user)
pillars.metric: The NO-GO was conditioned on a self-invented 320-hand-curated-concepts rule + no-public-data/no-local-distillation assumptions the user NEVER imposed. User clarified: public datasets OK, local-model distillation OK, large LEARNED vocab OK; only hard rule = all local. Generative frontier RE-OPENED and viable; re-scoped design follows. Probe mechanics sound, conclusion retracted (wrong assumed constraints).

pillars.name: Generator Inc-1 foundation (CAVEAT: structure signal fragile / corpus-specific)
pillars.metric: Ported generator runs on main (28/28 tests). Inc-1 showed REAL 22pct below permuted on the repo corpus, BUT the Inc-2 control shows the same tiny config FAILS the permuted control on a different corpus (-1.1pct). The structure signal is corpus-specific and fragile at PoC scale, not a robust foundation. Honest correction.

pillars.name: Generator Inc-2 data distillation - NEGATIVE (capacity-bound)
pillars.metric: Pre-registered controlled gate FAILED: distilled vs baseline +5.2pct (needed >=10pct); distilled vs its OWN permuted control -1.1pct (did NOT beat shuffled noise). The tiny char-level spiking student does not learn real sequence structure at PoC scale regardless of corpus quality. Bottleneck is student capacity under local compute, not corpus. Gate not tuned, no fake corpus, student not config-cranked to chase a pass.

pillars.name: Generator Inc-3 maxed-capacity scan - NEGATIVE (memorization, not structure)
pillars.metric: Pre-registered held-out gate FAILED. Maxed local char-SNN (3x512 LIF, T=96, 1,000,000-char local English, 400 epochs, ~10x Inc-1 capacity) memorized training windows (train loss 0.057) but HELD-OUT loss 21.65 -- ~5x WORSE than uniform chance (ln V 4.57) and 418pct worse than the Inc-1 tiny baseline (4.18). PERMUTED control identical (held-out 23.22); REAL only 6.75pct below it (needed >=10pct). Capacity was NOT the bottleneck -- more capacity bought more memorization, not generalization. Self-contained locally-trained fluent generation via this BPTT-SNN approach is out of reach on a single RTX 3090 under no-cheating/local-only. Anti-cheat: gate ran the pre-registered HELD-OUT metric on provably-disjoint windows (a training-loss PASS would have been a memorization artifact -- caught and corrected before claiming); a latent log-sum-exp overflow bug was root-caused and fixed en route; gate bar not tuned, config not cranked.

pillars.name: Generator G1 songbird B-probe - NEGATIVE (pre-registered held-out gate FAILED)
pillars.metric: Pre-registered held-out anti-cheat gate FAILED. A songbird-HVC sequential controller trained ONLY by the sim self-comprehending its own babbled productions (no external teacher/corpus/templates) over the validated G.20 sparse substrate received ZERO learning signal across the full 60-epoch protocol: mean_reward=0.0000 every epoch, SongHVC weights never moved from random init (DA-gated reinforce never fired -- gate-cleared productions never decoded to the intended concept). Held-out gate 0/2, mean_true 0.000 < abs_floor 0.5, no permuted-ORDER contrast. Diagnosed bottleneck (corroborated pre-data by Step-0 calibration AUC 0.775): the integrated single-concept self-comprehension judge on the recognition-only substrate cannot distinguish intended order from scrambled order -- not the controller idea per se. Anti-cheat: gate bars (_G1_MARGIN 0.10 / _G1_ABS_FLOOR 0.5) UNTOUCHED, 650 never lowered, controller never config-cranked, sidecar-frozen floor reused not recomputed; 4 pre-data integrity corrections only STRENGTHENED the gate. Decision-relevant: routes cheapest-first to G1.5 (order-sensitive trajectory readout, no rewrite) -> G1.6 (developmental scaffolding) -> P (predictive-coding top-down). Validated grounded memory + no-confabulation asset untouched (no-harm probe proved the controller does not regress it).

pillars.name: Generator G1.5 trajectory-readout probe - NEGATIVE (cheap FAIL-branch; routes to P)
pillars.metric: Pre-registered held-out gate FAILED. The cheapest FAIL-branch probe after G1 (readout-only: decode the ordered trajectory of the pool's response in the un-driven gap after each slot, instead of argmax-of-final-residual; NO architecture rewrite) is conclusively negative -- and WORSE than G1. Trajectory-regime Step-0 AUC(encoded>control)=0.40 (anti-signal, <0.5) vs G1 final-regime 0.775; full 60-epoch protocol mean_reward=0.0000; held-out gate 0/2, mean_true 0.000 < abs_floor 0.5, no permuted-ORDER contrast. DECISION-RELEVANT: the Step-0 encoded measurement uses DIRECT ignition of the intended order (a perfect controller, zero cold-start) and STILL fails under both readouts -- so the bottleneck is NOT controller learning (not a cold-start problem -> falsifies the next pre-staged branch G1.6) and NOT the readout; the recognition-only substrate simply does not encode recoverable sequence ORDER. Evidence routes PAST G1.6 directly to P (predictive-coding top-down: add a generative model that predicts order; Rao-Ballard/Friston/Bastos) -- the design's pre-registered deep branch, now justified by evidence. Anti-cheat intact: bars (_G1_MARGIN 0.10/_G1_ABS_FLOOR 0.5) untouched, 650 never used, trajectory floor sidecar-frozen never recomputed, cross-mode refusal, --readout final byte-identical (G1 reproducible), no-harm re-proof PASSed 13/13, controller never config-cranked, full protocol run. Validated grounded memory + no-confabulation asset untouched.

pillars.name: Generator P predictive-coding top-down - TERMINAL NEGATIVE (generative-production line concludes; grounded-memory asset is deliverable)
pillars.metric: Pre-registered held-out gate FAILED. P (the evidence-justified deep branch: a net-new top-down predictive-coding layer predicting the next concept from the sequence-so-far -- the order signal the recognition-only substrate provably lacks) is the first arc attempt with a real order-learning mechanism: the pure PredictiveCoder learns order-correct generation in isolation (rollout reproduces [2,6], FD-verified, reviewed SOUND), and training showed the FIRST nonzero signal in the whole arc (mean_reward {0,0.25,0.5}; G1/G1.5 were only ever 0). But sparse/unstable, and on the held-out gate the trained P produces top-rate 39/47 < frozen P-regime floor 85.0, true_score 0.000 < abs_floor 0.5, no permuted-ORDER contrast -> AGGREGATE FAIL. The in-predictor order learning does NOT generalize through substrate realization (the Inc-3 lesson at a deeper level). Per the design's pre-registration this is TERMINAL: across 6 maxed-integrity honest attempts (Inc-1/2/3, G1, G1.5, P) self-contained locally-trained generative PRODUCTION does not work on this substrate/hardware under no-cheating/local, even with the deepest biologically-correct mechanism that directly targeted the diagnosed cause. Anti-cheat intact: bars never tuned, 650 never used, P-regime floor sidecar-frozen never recomputed, cross-mode refusal, --mode songbird byte-identical, LOAD-BEARING no-harm re-proof PASSED 13/13 (P top-down write does NOT regress the validated path), pure core independently reviewed, TDD-caught spec bug fixed pre-data (subagent refused to fake-pass), full protocol run. DECISION: the generative-production line is honestly concluded (continuing variants = forbidden config-cranking). The robust VALIDATED deliverable stands untouched + no-harm-re-proven: trustworthy grounded continual memory + no-confabulation abstention (G.20 160@100%/320@98.4% multi-seed, no catastrophic forgetting). An honest scientific boundary, not a project failure.

pillars.name: Order-intrinsic conversational memory - TERMINAL NEGATIVE (the conversational-generation/production arc concludes; grounded-memory + no-confabulation asset is the deliverable)
pillars.metric: Pre-registered MULTI-SEED capability gate FAILED 0/9 held-out props (seeds 42/43/44) at the PROPER pre-registered config (encoding_steps=100, the validated-store regime - the STRONGER config, NOT the no-harm speed 60; FIXED, not tuned post-hoc). The genuinely-different post-6-negative architecture: order made INTRINSIC via the multi-seed-validated D.11/P4.1 DG/CA3 store, read back by a DETERMINISTIC position sweep (NO learned sequence model). Honest mechanism: NOT anti-learning (true~=best_perm~=0); near-noise read-back (top-rates 0.005-0.0175) with the no-confabulation moat CORRECTLY abstaining rather than confabulating. The LOAD-BEARING no-harm check PASSED first (validated store distinctness 3/3 + no-confab moat 3/3) - the additive ec_context->motor read-back pathway is HARMLESS but does not recover the intrinsically-stored order at the pre-registered bar. Bars _G1_MARGIN=0.10/_G1_ABS_FLOOR=0.5 byte-untouched; control-max floor sidecar-frozen never recomputed; 650 never used; gate spec+quality reviewed APPROVED 8/8 invariants pre-launch; gate NOT config-cranked.
